# MarkdownDisplay

**Class:** `UltraCanvasMarkdownDisplay` · **Group:** [Codes and documents](../Groups/Codes-and-documents.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Text/UltraCanvasMarkdown.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Text/UltraCanvasMarkdown.h) · `#include "Plugins/Text/UltraCanvasMarkdown.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Markdown rendered as a standalone display (`UltraCanvasTextArea`'s Markdown mode is the editable route)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasSmoothScroll](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasSmoothScroll.md)
- [UltraCanvasTextAreaExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTextAreaExamples.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasMarkdownDisplay> CreateMarkdownDisplay( const std::string& identifier = "MarkdownDisplay", float x = 0, float y = 0, float w = 400, float h = 300);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasMarkdownDisplay(const std::string& identifier = "MarkdownDisplay", float x = 0, float y = 0, float w = 400, float h = 300);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| `SetScrollChangedCallback()` | `void SetScrollChangedCallback(std::function<void(float)> callback)` | Takes a callback. |
